title: NATS request/reply studio.see (pipelines → studio)
description: From API 1.65 (contracts/README.md, Assistant: media and vision). Core NATS request/reply on subject `studio.see` (queue group `studio`), bare JSON: the pictures of one take for the assistant's own model when it sees images (cmd.assistant.turn settings.sees). Asked as the thread's owner: owner_id must own thread_id and the take (else not_found). Studio reads the take's thumbnail (an image's, a video's poster; else the image itself) and answers it as JPEG, its long side at most 1024 px; an audio take has no pictures. Never stored, never on a stream: the bytes go only into the model call. Studio answers within 5 s.

images.description: JPEG pictures, base64: an image's one, a video's poster (keyframes come with alpha.2 item 13), none for audio
